definition_catalyst.text: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Wood makes it grow, so what you build adds up. As a catalyst, the growth runs thin, and your hands have less to work on than they want. You build less than your strength could carry.

definition_friction.text: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Wood keeps it reaching, and building never feels done. As a friction, wanting outruns strength, and the work always asks for more than you have. You spend yourself faster than you refill.

definition_balanced.text: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Wood makes it grow, so what you build adds up. In balance, what you take on matches the strength you have to carry it. Each venture gets finished and pays its way.
definition_balanced.head: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Wood makes it grow, so what you build adds up.
definition_balanced.tail: In balance, what you take on matches the strength you have to carry it. Each venture gets finished and pays its way.

catalyst_keywords: Spots openings: Spotting openings is what you do before anything is obvious. Carrying less Wood than drive to spend, you notice the far chance more than the one in your hand. Half the good ideas in your circle started as something you pointed at.

Quick to start: Starting comes easily to you, often before you finish deciding. Moving is how you feel alive, so you start and learn rather than wait until you are sure. Whole projects exist because you went first while others were still talking.

Generous: Generosity comes more easily to you than keeping, especially money. Being generous makes the world feel wide, so you give away a good month rather than save it. More than one friend got through a hard year with your help.

Patient builder: Building slowly is where you feel most sure of yourself. You have more push than Wood to put it into, so you build one thing for years rather than chase several. Your work is still standing when quicker efforts have fallen.

Saves first: Saving comes before spending for you, without your ever deciding it. Being covered means more than anything you would buy, so you save instead of wanting. Your household weathers bad years that sink other families.

Loyal: Being loyal comes before being exciting for you. Being known feels safer than being wanted, so you stay loyal on dull days as much as good ones. The person beside you has never once doubted you.

definition_catalyst.text: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Fire fuels it, and outside demands shape you. As a catalyst, those demands come rarely, and you miss having something to answer to. You stay half-used until a real test arrives.

definition_friction.text: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Fire lights it, so standards reach you. As a friction, pressure piles up faster than you rest, and every demand feels like yours to meet. You end up tired and doubting yourself.

definition_balanced.text: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Fire fuels it, and outside demands shape you. In balance, demands come at a pace you can meet. You answer to fair rules and hold your rank without strain.
definition_balanced.head: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Fire fuels it, and outside demands shape you.
definition_balanced.tail: In balance, demands come at a pace you can meet. You answer to fair rules and hold your rank without strain.

catalyst_keywords: Clear under pressure: Pressure is where your thinking gets clear. Since you need certainty more than comfort, you let outside pressure clear your head rather than make your own calm. In a crisis, the people around you steady at the sound of your voice.

Takes charge: Taking charge comes to you before anyone offers it. Standing by while a group drifts feels worse than being wrong out loud, so you take charge before the vote. Around you, decisions get made and the work starts.

Loves high stakes: Nothing at stake feels to you like being passed over. Since you only come awake with something to lose, you take high stakes over sure things. Your nerve is what others lean on when the outcome is in doubt.

Keeps every promise: Every promise you make becomes a rule you keep. Being relied on is the closest you get to feeling safe, so you keep your word over your freedom to change it. People build their plans on your yes.
By the book: You trust a thing only when it is done by the book. Since an outside rule steadies you, you go by the book over the shortcut. Your work is the standard others get checked against.

Earns the title: A fairly earned title is worth more to you than any praise. Since an earned rank says you belong, you earn the next title instead of chasing the next thrill. What you want is a place no one could question.

definition_catalyst.text: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth makes it steady, so what you learn sinks in. As a catalyst, the ground runs short, and new things pass through before they settle. You take longer than most to trust what you learn.

definition_friction.text: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth holds it, and nothing you learn is lost. As a friction, the holding never stops, and you take in far more than you ever act on. You stay put well past the time to move.

definition_balanced.text: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth makes it steady, so what you learn sinks in. In balance, what you take in settles at a steady pace. You trust what you learn and still let new things in.

catalyst_keywords: Self-taught: Teaching yourself matters more to you than being taught. Needing to understand before you trust, you teach yourself from odd sources rather than take the standard lesson. What you learn this way goes deep and stays put.

Reads between lines: You read between the lines before you finish the lines. Needing to know a thing from underneath, you trust what sits between the words over what they say. Very little gets past you, least of all what people leave unsaid.

Solo thinker: Thinking alone is how you do your best thinking. Because you need the whole picture before you share any of it, you want the quiet more than the company. Ideas come back from those hours finished and fully yours.

Calming presence: Your presence calms people before your words do. Since you need people safe rather than impressed, you calm them with the slow question before the fix. A worried table goes quiet soon after you sit down at it.

Knows what works: Knowing what works comes easier to you than hoping something unproven will. Because you need an answer to have lasted, you reach for what has worked over what sounds clever. People bring you their trouble because your advice holds up.

Patient teacher: You teach a thing a third time with the patience of the first. Needing the person to get there, you teach at their pace instead of your own. Whatever someone learns from you, they learn without shame.

definition_catalyst.text: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Metal makes it hard, and your will holds. Running thin, your strength gives out sooner than you let on. You spend it as if it were full and seldom stop to refill.

definition_friction.text: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Metal keeps it exact, so your standard holds. Running over, your strength has nowhere to go and gets spent holding your ground against the people beside you. You lose a peer for each argument you win.

definition_balanced.text: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Metal makes it hard, and your will holds. In balance, your strength is firm but never stiff. You stand on your own and still let a peer share the weight.
definition_balanced.head: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Metal makes it hard, and your will holds.
definition_balanced.tail: In balance, your strength is firm but never stiff. You stand on your own and still let a peer share the weight.

catalyst_keywords: Self-made: You built your own standard with no one watching. Making a thing yourself feels safer than being measured on it, so you build alone rather than with help. Every part of your life carries your fingerprints and nobody else's.

Even-handed: You hold everyone to the same measure as yourself. Fairness feels cleaner to you than favour, so being even with someone comes before being easy on them. Every person in your circle gets an honest deal and knows it.

Recovers alone: Your strength recovers alone and gets spent in company. Being seen low feels like a debt you never repay, so you recover quietly instead of calling anyone. What you want is to walk back in whole, owing no one.

Competitive: You compete best with someone to beat, and you know it. Knowing where you stand matters more than comfort, so you compete harder against one rival than for any reward. A worthy opponent pulls out of you a level that practice never reaches.

First to bet: Your yes to a bet comes before the fear has finished. Hesitating feels like losing to yourself, so you bet first and size it afterwards. Ventures that would have died in committee find their backer in you.

Shares the risk: You trust a person faster when the risk is shared. Sharing the risk makes the bond real to you, so you go in together before writing anything down. The partner you want is one with as much to lose as you.

advise_catalyst.text: What you have to give runs short, and it counts for nothing until someone hears it. Tell one person a story with no lesson in it. Ask them what they took from it, and listen to the end.

definition_catalyst.text: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water makes it flow, and what you feel comes out. As a catalyst, the flow runs short. Your kindness and wit come out fast and then run dry.

definition_friction.text: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water pours it out until nothing stays in. As a friction, the gate never shuts, and more goes out of you than comes back. You run empty long before you run quiet.

definition_balanced.text: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water makes it flow, and what you feel comes out. In balance, the gate opens and closes when you choose. Your kindness and wit come out at the moment they are needed.
definition_balanced.head: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water makes it flow, and what you feel comes out.
definition_balanced.tail: In balance, the gate opens and closes when you choose. Your kindness and wit come out at the moment they are needed.

catalyst_keywords: Giving: Giving comes to you before anyone has asked, the most natural thing you do. Being needed feels closer to safe than being admired, and you give the help before the ask. You were never giving to earn your place.

Unforced: What you make is unforced, and you hardly notice how rare that is. Since effort is the only proof you trust, you put what you forced ahead of what came easily. Your best pieces put people at ease the moment they see them.

Warm: Warmth matters to you more than winning the point, and an easy evening is where you are most yourself. This is why you make the warmth around you on purpose. People stay longer at your table than they meant to.

Quick-witted: Your wit answers before your care does, and mostly you let it. Since being quick is how you know you are awake, you put the quick answer ahead of the careful one. Talk turns lively the moment you join it.

Original: Doing a thing the usual way is nearly impossible for you, and only an original one feels done. Taking it apart first, you make your own version rather than follow the rule. Your work carries a mark nobody else could have left.

Speaks up: Not speaking up about something wrong is almost physically hard for you. You speak up rather than being liked, because a true sentence left unsaid feels like a lie you took part in. You are usually the only one who will.
